advancement.minecartrevolution.got_ameth: Place an Amethyst Minecart near a Jukebox Minecart to relay its music further
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_obser: Place an Observer inside a minecart to get the Langton's Ant Minecart
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_lava_: Drift across lava on an Obsidian Minecart
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_dange: I better not get too close...
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_lava_: A lava minecart. We strongly advise against offering anyone a ride.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_campf: Nothing says 'cozy' quite like a fire hazard rolling down the track.
advancement.minecartrevolution.move_on_j: Ride a moving Jukebox Minecart on tour
advancement.minecartrevolution.sofa_away: Sit on a moving Sofa Minecart for 5 seconds and enjoy the music
advancement.minecartrevolution.no_gravit: Place wool inside a minecart to make it weightless
advancement.minecartrevolution.is_that_b: Is That the Tower of Babel?
Stack more than 10 minecarts using Rail Minecarts
advancement.minecartrevolution.babel.des: Experience the collapse of a minecart tower taller than 24 layers
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_spong: Turn a sponge into a minecart, because why carry a bucket when you can drive one?
advancement.minecartrevolution.sponge_ab: Your sponge minecart just drank the whole area dry. Thirsty little cart.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_barre: Not the monkey kind. A barrel minecart for all your mobile storage needs.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_trapp: A chest on wheels that shocks anyone who opens it. Great for trolling friends.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_coppe: A copper chest minecart. It'll look a bit different in a few weeks.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_shulk: A shulker on rails. Your inventory thanks you for the extra breathing room.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_ender: Your personal vault is now also a vehicle. Peak efficiency.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_dispe: A dispenser on wheels. Please aim responsibly... or don't.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_beaco: The Light at the End of the Track
A beacon minecart that buffs everyone nearby. Who needs a pyramid?
advancement.minecartrevolution.beacon_ac: Your beacon minecart is dispensing free buffs to all nearby players. It's basically a rolling therapy session.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_honey: A honey block minecart. Drive carefully — it tends to get a little attached.
advancement.minecartrevolution.honey_stu: Your honey minecart is now one with the wall. It's not going anywhere. Neither are you.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_porta: Who needs a fixed portal when you can take it for a ride?
advancement.minecartrevolution.portal_te: You just got teleported by a minecart. That's not how trains usually work.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_ender: The End is Near... and Mobile
An End Portal Minecart. You've gone too far. No turning back now.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_magne: A lodestone minecart that pulls items toward it. Finally, a minecart with good vibes.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_pisto: A piston on rails. It will push things. Whether you want it to or not.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_scaff: Now you can bring the construction site to you. OSHA has left the chat.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_cobwe: A cobweb minecart. Perfect for making everyone around you feel like they're wading through syrup.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_water: A minecart full of water. Mind the splash damage... and the passengers.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_mob_h: A dragon head on a minecart. Villagers will not be amused.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_encha: A rolling enchanting table. Now you can get that Sharpness V between stops.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_anvil: An anvil minecart. Gravity plus momentum — what could possibly go wrong?
advancement.minecartrevolution.ride_anvi: You actually sat on the anvil minecart. We salute your bravery. Or your recklessness.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_craft: A crafting table minecart. Your daily commute just became your workshop.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_smith: A smithing table on rails. Your upgrade addiction now has zero downtime.
advancement.minecartrevolution.got_picke: A minecart that picks up everything it rolls over. Like a very ambitious Roomba.
message.minecartrevolution.chain_selecte: Minecart selected! Right-click another minecart to link with chain.
message.minecartrevolution.chain_already: One of these minecarts is already chained! Break the existing chain first.
